title: Propagate context_pack semantic fail reasons into cold-start retry metadata
outcome: Propagate context_pack semantic fail reasons into cold-start retry metadata
acceptance: A production-shaped DefinitionAsync failure with FailReason cluster_cold_load and null PartialReason yields the documented partialReason, retryRecommended:true, and retryHint.
Permanent semantic failures do not acquire retry metadata.

completion.summary: context_pack now propagates DefinitionAsync FailReason into typed partial/retry metadata, with a production-shaped regression.
